text.Scrollable image: PolyPDF confirmation d: Scrollbares Bild: Deutsches PolyPDF nach Anwendung der Schwärzung mit schwarzer Kennungsfläche und Keine Treffer im Suchbereich
text.PolyPDF states what it is about to do be: Nach der Bestätigung ist die Kennung im geöffneten Dokument entfernt. Der Suchbereich zeigt Keine Treffer; die Planbeschriftungen und das separate Rasterdetail bleiben erhalten. Speichern und erneutes Öffnen stehen an dieser Stelle noch aus.
text.PolyPDF showing an applied black redacti: Gespeicherter deutscher A3-Prüfplan nach App-Neustart mit erneut erfolgloser Suche nach VORGANG-LINDE-742
text.Scrollable image: PolyPDF showing an app: Scrollbares Bild: Gespeicherter deutscher A3-Prüfplan nach App-Neustart mit erneut erfolgloser Suche nach VORGANG-LINDE-742
text.After Apply, the black region covers the: Nach Speichern unter… und vollständigem Neustart bleibt die Schwärzung erhalten. Die Suche in pruefplan-geschwaerzt.pdf findet die Kennung nicht mehr. Die unabhängige Prüfung bezieht sich auf genau diese gespeicherten Bytes.
text.For a token like this one, the saved fil: Für dieses Beispiel stimmen die Prüfungen überein: keine Kennung in der App-Suche, im unabhängig extrahierten Text, in den Rohbytes oder in den geprüften dekodierten PDF-Objekten. Der übrige Seitentext und die Bildpixel bleiben unverändert. Die Ausgabe enthält keine Verknüpfung auf eine frühere PDF-Revision. Daraus folgt keine allgemeine Zusicherung für Bilder, Vektorpfade oder andere PDF-Strukturen.
text.Treat images, outlines, and nested graph: Bilder, Konturen und verschachtelte Grafiken gesondert behandeln
text.PolyPDF detects top-level image placemen: Die Prüfung auf überlappende Bilder deckt nicht jede verschachtelte Form-Struktur ab. In Pfade umgewandelte Schrift ist ebenfalls kein gewöhnlicher Textbefehl. Solche Inhalte können unter einer schwarzen Fläche erhalten bleiben. Die deutsche Übung schwärzt deshalb ausschließlich die einzeln suchbare Kennung und lässt das separate Bild unverändert.
text.Do not infer content type from appearanc: Bestimmen Sie den Inhaltstyp. Ein Suchtreffer belegt nur diese Textstelle, nicht den Aufbau der übrigen Seite.
text.Do not flatten, rasterize, print, or cov: Reduzieren, Rastern, Drucken oder Überdecken allein ist kein Nachweis, dass unerwünschte Inhalte vollständig entfernt wurden.
text.For a scanned page or image-based identi: Für gescannte Seiten oder Kennungen in Bildern benötigen Sie ein Verfahren, das die betreffenden Bildpixel tatsächlich entfernt.
text.For outlined or vector lettering, requir: Bei Schriftkonturen und Vektorgrafiken müssen die zugrunde liegenden Zeichenbefehle entfernt oder ersetzt werden.
text.If you cannot independently inspect the: Geben Sie vertrauliche Inhalte erst nach der dafür vorgesehenen unabhängigen Prüfung frei.

library.intro.source: Explore the fictional Willow Creek Community Center through coordinated architectural, structural, civil, MEP, and finish drawings. Every PDF contains two bookmarked ARCH D sheets (36 × 24 inches), with drawing numbers, schedules, legends, dimensions, and details.

Chaque PDF contient deux feuilles A1 (841 × 594 mm) avec signets, numéros de plans, nomenclatures, légendes, cotes et détails.

Calibrate each view before measuring. Use the sheet-specific examples below. The earlier F-101 and E-101 exercises use different drawings and quantities.
library.scope.target: Ces dessins originaux servent à la démonstration. Ce ne sont ni des documents de permis ni des résultats enregistrés par PolyPDF. Les plans de niveau sont au 1:50 ; les plans de masse et les détails ont d’autres échelles. Étalonnez chaque vue avant de mesurer. Utilisez les exercices propres à chaque feuille ci-dessous. Les anciens exercices F-101 et E-101 utilisent d’autres dessins et quantités.

exercise.takeoff.title.source: Measure the Willow Creek architectural plan
exercise.takeoff.title.target: Mesurer le plan architectural de la Maison de quartier des Tilleuls

exercise.takeoff.step1.source: Open A101, Revision A. Calibrate the printed 20 ft reference; it spans 360 PDF points.
exercise.takeoff.step1.target: Ouvrez A101, indice A. Étalonnez la longueur de référence imprimée de 5,00 m : au 1:50, elle correspond à environ 283,46457 points PDF.

exercise.takeoff.step2.source: Check the independent 96 ft width and 60 ft depth, then trace the outside building boundary.
exercise.takeoff.step2.target: Contrôlez séparément la largeur de 24,00 m et la profondeur de 15,00 m, puis tracez le contour extérieur du bâtiment.

exercise.takeoff.step3.source: Compare the gross area with 5,760 sq ft. Keep sheet, revision, subject, unit, and total with the exported record.
exercise.takeoff.step3.target: Comparez l’emprise rectangulaire à 360,00 m². Conservez le plan, l’indice, l’objet, l’unité et le total avec la mesure exportée.

exercise.takeoff.scope.source: This is a gross footprint exercise. It does not measure net flooring or subtract walls. The two length checks and one area use three manual measurements.
exercise.takeoff.scope.target: Cet exercice porte sur l’emprise rectangulaire brute. Il ne mesure pas le sol net et ne déduit pas les murs. Les deux contrôles de longueur et la mesure de surface sont trois mesures manuelles.

exercise.provenance.source: Drawing reference values, not new app test results. Work on a copy and check your own saved output.
exercise.provenance.target: Les valeurs sont des références du dessin, pas de nouveaux résultats de tests de l’application. Travaillez sur une copie et vérifiez votre fichier enregistré.

exercise.flooring.title.source: Take off finishes from the Willow Creek interiors plan
exercise.flooring.title.target: Métrer les revêtements de la Maison de quartier des Tilleuls

exercise.flooring.step1.source: Open I101 and calibrate its 20 ft reference. Read the F1 and F2 finish key before measuring.
exercise.flooring.step1.target: Ouvrez I101 et étalonnez sa référence de 5,00 m. Lisez la légende des revêtements F1 et F2 avant de mesurer.

exercise.flooring.step2.source: Trace the dimension-boundary zones for tiled rooms 107 and 108 separately: 288 sq ft each, or 576 sq ft together.
exercise.flooring.step2.target: Tracez séparément les zones cotées des pièces carrelées 107 et 108 : 18,00 m² chacune, soit 36,00 m² au total.

exercise.flooring.step3.source: Compare F2 tile with 576 sq ft and F1 resilient flooring with 5,184 sq ft. Apply any waste allowance separately.
exercise.flooring.step3.target: Comparez le carrelage F2 à 36,00 m² et le sol souple F1 à 324,00 m². Appliquez séparément toute majoration pour les chutes.

exercise.flooring.scope.source: The authored finish schedule uses room dimension boundaries without wall-thickness deductions. These exercise areas are not net installed quantities; I501 details use different scales.
exercise.flooring.scope.target: La nomenclature utilise les limites cotées des pièces sans déduire l’épaisseur des murs. Ces surfaces d’exercice ne sont pas des quantités nettes posées ; les détails I501 utilisent d’autres échelles.

exercise.electrical.title.source: Count the Willow Creek lighting plan
exercise.electrical.title.target: Compter les symboles du plan électrique des Tilleuls

exercise.electrical.step1.source: Open E101 and identify the luminaire symbol in the legend. Count only the plan, excluding legend and detail examples.
exercise.electrical.step1.target: Ouvrez E101 et repérez le symbole de luminaire dans la légende. Comptez uniquement les symboles du plan, en excluant les exemples de légende et de détail.

exercise.electrical.step2.source: Review 24 plan luminaires, including 4 emergency luminaires. The emergency subset is included in 24, not added to it.
exercise.electrical.step2.target: Vérifiez les 24 luminaires, 12 prises de courant et 8 interrupteurs du plan. Conservez des quantités distinctes pour ces trois catégories.

exercise.electrical.step3.source: Calibrate the 20 ft reference. Trace the LP-1 / CKTS 1, 3, 5, 7 diagram from the panel, then north and east: 8 + 38 = 46 ft.
exercise.electrical.step3.target: Étalonnez la référence de 5,00 m. Tracez le cheminement schématique sur E101 et comparez-le à 34,50 m. E501 contient le schéma électrique et la nomenclature des luminaires.

exercise.electrical.scope.source: The dashed wiring is a circuit diagram, not a conduit takeoff. Pro is required for Symbol Search; review every candidate. The 24 fixtures and 46 ft are drawing references, not app results.
exercise.electrical.scope.target: Le tracé en pointillés représente un cheminement schématique, pas un métré de conduits à exécuter. La recherche de symboles nécessite Pro ; vérifiez chaque proposition. Les 24 luminaires, 12 prises, 8 interrupteurs et 34,50 m sont des références du dessin, pas des résultats de l’application.

exercise.compare.title.source: Compare the Willow Creek architectural revisions
exercise.compare.title.target: Comparer les indices architecturaux de la Maison de quartier des Tilleuls

exercise.compare.step1.source: Open Revision A and Revision B. Pair A101 with A101 and A201 with A201; keep the full sheet extents aligned.
exercise.compare.step1.target: Ouvrez les indices A et B. Associez A101 à A101 et A201 à A201 ; alignez les feuilles A1 dans leur intégralité.

exercise.compare.step2.source: On A101, review the 6 ft partition shift between rooms 103 and 104 and the 3 ft movement of the room 104 door.
exercise.compare.step2.target: Sur A101, examinez le déplacement de 1,50 m vers l’est de la cloison entre les pièces 103 et 104, puis celui de 0,75 m vers l’est de la porte de la pièce 104.

exercise.compare.step3.source: Review the added 6 ft south glazing on A101 and A201, then check the revised issue fields and notes.
exercise.compare.step3.target: Examinez le vitrage sud ajouté de 1,50 m sur A101 et A201, puis les champs d’émission et les notes modifiés.

exercise.review.title.source: Review the Willow Creek coordination sheets
exercise.review.title.target: Vérifier les plans de synthèse de la Maison de quartier des Tilleuls

exercise.review.step1.source: Open X101 and inspect the three numbered coordination issues and their existing sticky notes.
exercise.review.step1.target: Ouvrez X101 et examinez les trois points de synthèse numérotés et leurs notes PDF existantes.

exercise.review.step2.source: Use X102 to match each location to its issue, trade, status, and requested response. Add your own review markup on a copy.
exercise.review.step2.target: Utilisez X102 pour associer chaque emplacement à sa question, son lot, son état et la réponse demandée. Ajoutez vos propres annotations sur une copie.

exercise.review.step3.source: Save the copy, reopen it, and inspect the annotations and any exported Markup Table before handing it off.
exercise.review.step3.target: Enregistrez la copie, rouvrez-la et vérifiez les annotations ainsi que tout tableau d’annotations exporté avant transmission.

exercise.review.scope.source: The source contains three authored issues and four PDF layers. These are fictional coordination exercises; no engineering or code-compliance conclusion is established.
exercise.review.scope.target: La source contient trois points préparés pour l’exercice et quatre calques PDF. Ces exercices fictifs de synthèse ne constituent ni une validation technique ni une attestation de conformité réglementaire.

exercise.ocr.step1.target: Ouvrez le jeu de plans numérisés et recherchez SALLE POLYVALENTE. Le PDF original de deux pages contient des images sans texte natif.

exercise.ocr.step2.source: Run OCR on a working copy. Search for COMMUNITY ROOM on A101 and SITE PLAN on C101, then inspect the recognized text.

exercise.takeoff.step2.source: Check the independent 96 ft width and 60 ft depth, then trace the outside building boundary.

exercise.takeoff.step3.source: Compare the gross area with 5,760 sq ft. Keep sheet, revision, subject, unit, and total with the exported record.

exercise.takeoff.scope.source: This is a gross footprint exercise. It does not measure net flooring or subtract walls. The two length checks and one area use three manual measurements.

exercise.flooring.step2.source: Trace the dimension-boundary zones for tiled rooms 107 and 108 separately: 288 sq ft each, or 576 sq ft together.
exercise.flooring.step2.target: Trace por separado las zonas acotadas de los aseos 107 y 108: 18,00 m² cada una, 36,00 m² en total.

exercise.flooring.step3.source: Compare F2 tile with 576 sq ft and F1 resilient flooring with 5,184 sq ft. Apply any waste allowance separately.

exercise.electrical.step3.source: Calibrate the 20 ft reference. Trace the LP-1 / CKTS 1, 3, 5, 7 diagram from the panel, then north and east: 8 + 38 = 46 ft.

exercise.compare.step1.target: Abra las revisiones A y B. Empareje A101 con A101 y A201 con A201; alinee las hojas A1 completas.

exercise.compare.step2.source: On A101, review the 6 ft partition shift between rooms 103 and 104 and the 3 ft movement of the room 104 door.
exercise.compare.step2.target: En A101, examine el desplazamiento de 1,50 m hacia el este del tabique entre las estancias 103 y 104 y el de 0,75 m hacia el este de la puerta de la estancia 104.

exercise.compare.step3.source: Review the added 6 ft south glazing on A101 and A201, then check the revised issue fields and notes.
exercise.compare.step3.target: Examine la nueva ventana sur de 1,50 m en A101 y A201, y los campos de emisión y las notas modificados.

exercise.compare.scope.source: Room 103 changes from 576 to 720 sq ft; room 104 changes from 576 to 432 sq ft. The gross footprint stays 5,760 sq ft. These are authored changes, not a promised detection count.

exercise.review.step1.target: Abra X101 y examine las tres incidencias de coordinación numeradas y sus notas PDF existentes.

exercise.review.step2.source: Use X102 to match each location to its issue, trade, status, and requested response. Add your own review markup on a copy.

library.intro.source: Explore the fictional Willow Creek Community Center through coordinated architectural, structural, civil, MEP, and finish drawings. Every PDF contains two bookmarked ARCH D sheets (36 × 24 inches), with drawing numbers, schedules, legends, dimensions, and details.
library.intro.target: Esplora il Centro Civico dei Tigli, un progetto fittizio in Italia, attraverso disegni coordinati di architettura, strutture, sistemazioni esterne, impianti e finiture. Ogni PDF contiene due tavole A1 con segnalibri, numeri di tavola, abachi, legende, quote e dettagli.

library.scope.source: These are original demonstration drawings, not permit documents or verified PolyPDF outputs. The main building plans use 1/4 inch = 1 foot; site and detail scales vary. Calibrate each view before measuring. Use the sheet-specific examples below. The earlier F-101 and E-101 exercises use different drawings and quantities.
library.scope.target: Questi disegni originali servono per esercitazioni; non sono documenti autorizzativi né risultati verificati di PolyPDF. Le piante principali sono in scala 1:50 e le planimetrie in scala 1:200; i dettagli hanno scale proprie. Calibra ogni vista prima di misurare e segui gli esercizi qui sotto. I precedenti esercizi statunitensi F-101 ed E-101 usano disegni e quantità differenti.

exercise.takeoff.step1.source: Open A101, Revision A. Calibrate the printed 20 ft reference; it spans 360 PDF points.
exercise.takeoff.step1.target: Open A101, revisie A. Kalibreer de afgedrukte referentielengte van 5,00 m: op schaal 1:50 komt deze overeen met ongeveer 283,46457 PDF-punten.

exercise.takeoff.step2.source: Check the independent 96 ft width and 60 ft depth, then trace the outside building boundary.
exercise.takeoff.step2.target: Controleer de breedte van 24,00 m en de diepte van 15,00 m afzonderlijk en trek vervolgens de buitenomtrek van het gebouw na.

exercise.takeoff.step3.source: Compare the gross area with 5,760 sq ft. Keep sheet, revision, subject, unit, and total with the exported record.
exercise.takeoff.step3.target: Vergelijk de rechthoekige voetafdruk met 360,00 m². Bewaar blad, revisie, onderwerp, eenheid en totaal bij de geëxporteerde meting.

exercise.takeoff.scope.source: This is a gross footprint exercise. It does not measure net flooring or subtract walls. The two length checks and one area use three manual measurements.
exercise.takeoff.scope.target: Deze oefening meet de bruto rechthoekige voetafdruk. Ze meet geen netto vloeroppervlak en trekt geen wanden af. De twee lengtecontroles en de oppervlaktemeting zijn drie handmatige metingen.

exercise.provenance.source: Drawing reference values, not new app test results. Work on a copy and check your own saved output.
exercise.provenance.target: Dit zijn referentiewaarden uit de tekening, geen nieuwe app-testresultaten. Werk op een kopie en controleer je opgeslagen bestand.

exercise.historicalMac.target: Eerder Amerikaans voorbeeld: bekijk het op de Mac opgeslagen bestand en de geteste lokale versie →

exercise.flooring.title.source: Take off finishes from the Willow Creek interiors plan
exercise.flooring.title.target: Meet de vloeren van Wijkcentrum De Linde

exercise.flooring.step1.source: Open I101 and calibrate its 20 ft reference. Read the F1 and F2 finish key before measuring.
exercise.flooring.step1.target: Open I101 en kalibreer de referentie van 5,00 m. Lees de legenda voor vloerafwerkingen F1 en F2 voordat je meet.

exercise.flooring.step2.source: Trace the dimension-boundary zones for tiled rooms 107 and 108 separately: 288 sq ft each, or 576 sq ft together.
exercise.flooring.step2.target: Trek de bemate gebieden van toiletruimten 107 en 108 afzonderlijk na: elk 18,00 m², samen 36,00 m².

exercise.flooring.step3.source: Compare F2 tile with 576 sq ft and F1 resilient flooring with 5,184 sq ft. Apply any waste allowance separately.
exercise.flooring.step3.target: Vergelijk tegelvloer F2 met 36,00 m² en veerkrachtige vloer F1 met 324,00 m². Pas eventuele toeslagen voor snijverlies afzonderlijk toe.

exercise.flooring.scope.source: The authored finish schedule uses room dimension boundaries without wall-thickness deductions. These exercise areas are not net installed quantities; I501 details use different scales.
exercise.flooring.scope.target: De staat gebruikt de bemate ruimtebegrenzingen zonder aftrek van wanddikten. Deze oefenoppervlakten zijn geen netto aangebrachte hoeveelheden; de details op I501 hebben andere schalen.

exercise.electrical.title.source: Count the Willow Creek lighting plan
exercise.electrical.title.target: Tel de symbolen op het elektrotechnische plan van De Linde

exercise.electrical.step1.source: Open E101 and identify the luminaire symbol in the legend. Count only the plan, excluding legend and detail examples.
exercise.electrical.step1.target: Open E101 en herken het armatuursymbool in de legenda. Tel alleen de symbolen in de plattegrond; sluit voorbeelden in de legenda en details uit.

exercise.electrical.step2.source: Review 24 plan luminaires, including 4 emergency luminaires. The emergency subset is included in 24, not added to it.
exercise.electrical.step2.target: Controleer de 24 armaturen, 12 wandcontactdozen en 8 schakelaars in de plattegrond. Houd de drie categorieën afzonderlijk bij.

exercise.electrical.step3.source: Calibrate the 20 ft reference. Trace the LP-1 / CKTS 1, 3, 5, 7 diagram from the panel, then north and east: 8 + 38 = 46 ft.
exercise.electrical.step3.target: Kalibreer de referentie van 5,00 m. Trek het schematische tracé op E101 na en vergelijk het met 34,50 m. E501 bevat het elektrische schema en de armaturenstaat.

exercise.electrical.scope.source: The dashed wiring is a circuit diagram, not a conduit takeoff. Pro is required for Symbol Search; review every candidate. The 24 fixtures and 46 ft are drawing references, not app results.
exercise.electrical.scope.target: De stippellijn toont een schematisch tracé, geen uitvoeringshoeveelheid voor installatiebuizen. Symbolen zoeken vereist Pro; controleer elk voorstel. De 24 armaturen, 12 wandcontactdozen, 8 schakelaars en 34,50 m zijn tekeningreferenties, geen app-resultaten.

exercise.compare.title.source: Compare the Willow Creek architectural revisions
exercise.compare.title.target: Vergelijk de bouwkundige revisies van Wijkcentrum De Linde

exercise.compare.step1.source: Open Revision A and Revision B. Pair A101 with A101 and A201 with A201; keep the full sheet extents aligned.
exercise.compare.step1.target: Open revisie A en revisie B. Koppel A101 aan A101 en A201 aan A201; lijn de volledige A1-bladen op elkaar uit.

exercise.compare.step2.source: On A101, review the 6 ft partition shift between rooms 103 and 104 and the 3 ft movement of the room 104 door.
exercise.compare.step2.target: Controleer op A101 de verplaatsing van de wand tussen ruimten 103 en 104 met 1,50 m naar het oosten en die van de deur van ruimte 104 met 0,75 m naar het oosten.

exercise.compare.step3.source: Review the added 6 ft south glazing on A101 and A201, then check the revised issue fields and notes.
exercise.compare.step3.target: Controleer het nieuwe zuidraam van 1,50 m op A101 en A201, en bekijk de gewijzigde uitgiftegegevens en opmerkingen.

exercise.compare.scope.source: Room 103 changes from 576 to 720 sq ft; room 104 changes from 576 to 432 sq ft. The gross footprint stays 5,760 sq ft. These are authored changes, not a promised detection count.
exercise.compare.scope.target: Ruimte 103 verandert van 36,00 naar 45,00 m²; ruimte 104 van 36,00 naar 27,00 m². De voetafdruk blijft 360,00 m². Dit zijn vooraf getekende wijzigingen, geen gegarandeerd aantal gedetecteerde verschillen.

exercise.review.title.source: Review the Willow Creek coordination sheets
exercise.review.title.target: Controleer de installatiecoördinatie van Wijkcentrum De Linde

exercise.review.step1.source: Open X101 and inspect the three numbered coordination issues and their existing sticky notes.
exercise.review.step1.target: Open X101 en bekijk de drie genummerde coördinatieknelpunten en de bijbehorende bestaande PDF-notities.

exercise.review.step2.source: Use X102 to match each location to its issue, trade, status, and requested response. Add your own review markup on a copy.
exercise.review.step2.target: Gebruik X102 om elke locatie te koppelen aan het knelpunt, de discipline, de status en de gevraagde reactie. Voeg je eigen controleannotaties toe aan een kopie.

exercise.review.step3.source: Save the copy, reopen it, and inspect the annotations and any exported Markup Table before handing it off.
exercise.review.step3.target: Sla de kopie op, open haar opnieuw en controleer de annotaties en een eventueel geëxporteerde annotatietabel vóór overdracht.

exercise.review.scope.source: The source contains three authored issues and four PDF layers. These are fictional coordination exercises; no engineering or code-compliance conclusion is established.
exercise.review.scope.target: Het origineel bevat drie oefenknelpunten en vier PDF-lagen. Deze fictieve coördinatieoefeningen vormen geen technische goedkeuring of bewijs van naleving van voorschriften.

exercise.ocr.title.source: Test OCR on the Willow Creek scanned sheets
exercise.ocr.title.target: Probeer OCR op de gescande tekeningen van De Linde

exercise.ocr.step1.source: Open the scanned set and try searching for WILLOW CREEK. The original two-page PDF contains images without native text.
exercise.ocr.step1.target: Open de gescande set en zoek MULTIFUNCTIONELE ZAAL. De oorspronkelijke PDF van twee pagina's bevat afbeeldingen zonder oorspronkelijke tekstlaag.

exercise.ocr.step2.source: Run OCR on a working copy. Search for COMMUNITY ROOM on A101 and SITE PLAN on C101, then inspect the recognized text.
exercise.ocr.step2.target: Voer OCR uit op een werkkopie. Zoek MULTIFUNCTIONELE ZAAL op A101 en SITUATIE EN NUTSLEIDINGEN op C101 en controleer de herkende tekst.

exercise.ocr.step3.source: Save and reopen the result. Repeat the searches and visually check dimensions before measuring the scanned drawing.
exercise.ocr.step3.target: Sla het resultaat op en open het opnieuw. Herhaal de zoekopdrachten en controleer de maten visueel voordat je de gescande tekening meet.

exercise.ocr.scope.source: Search targets are printed source text, not a promise of recognition accuracy. OCR does not repair drawing scale or scan distortion.
exercise.ocr.scope.target: De zoektermen staan op de oorspronkelijke tekeningen; correcte herkenning is niet gegarandeerd. OCR herstelt geen tekenschaal of scanvervorming.

exercise.provenance.source: Drawing reference values, not new app test results. Work on a copy and check your own saved output.

exercise.flooring.step1.source: Open I101 and calibrate its 20 ft reference. Read the F1 and F2 finish key before measuring.
exercise.flooring.step1.target: Otwórz I101 i skalibruj odcinek wzorcowy 5,00 m. Przed pomiarem przeczytaj legendę wykończenia F1 i F2.

exercise.flooring.step2.source: Trace the dimension-boundary zones for tiled rooms 107 and 108 separately: 288 sq ft each, or 576 sq ft together.
exercise.flooring.step2.target: Obrysuj osobno zwymiarowane obszary toalet 107 i 108: po 18,00 m², łącznie 36,00 m².

exercise.flooring.step3.source: Compare F2 tile with 576 sq ft and F1 resilient flooring with 5,184 sq ft. Apply any waste allowance separately.

exercise.flooring.scope.source: The authored finish schedule uses room dimension boundaries without wall-thickness deductions. These exercise areas are not net installed quantities; I501 details use different scales.

exercise.electrical.step1.source: Open E101 and identify the luminaire symbol in the legend. Count only the plan, excluding legend and detail examples.
exercise.electrical.step1.target: Otwórz E101 i rozpoznaj symbol oprawy w legendzie. Zliczaj wyłącznie symbole na rzucie; pomiń przykłady w legendzie i detalach.

exercise.electrical.step2.source: Review 24 plan luminaires, including 4 emergency luminaires. The emergency subset is included in 24, not added to it.
exercise.electrical.step2.target: Sprawdź 24 oprawy, 12 gniazd i 8 łączników na rzucie. Prowadź osobne zliczenia dla trzech kategorii.

exercise.electrical.step3.source: Calibrate the 20 ft reference. Trace the LP-1 / CKTS 1, 3, 5, 7 diagram from the panel, then north and east: 8 + 38 = 46 ft.

exercise.electrical.scope.source: The dashed wiring is a circuit diagram, not a conduit takeoff. Pro is required for Symbol Search; review every candidate. The 24 fixtures and 46 ft are drawing references, not app results.
exercise.electrical.scope.target: Linia przerywana przedstawia schematyczną trasę, nie przedmiar rur instalacyjnych. Wyszukiwanie symboli wymaga Pro; sprawdź każde wskazanie. 24 oprawy, 12 gniazd, 8 łączników i 34,50 m to wartości z rysunku, nie wyniki aplikacji.

exercise.compare.step1.source: Open Revision A and Revision B. Pair A101 with A101 and A201 with A201; keep the full sheet extents aligned.
exercise.compare.step1.target: Otwórz rewizję A i rewizję B. Połącz A101 z A101 oraz A201 z A201; wyrównaj pełne obrysy arkuszy A1.

exercise.compare.step2.source: On A101, review the 6 ft partition shift between rooms 103 and 104 and the 3 ft movement of the room 104 door.
exercise.compare.step2.target: Na A101 sprawdź przesunięcie ściany między pomieszczeniami 103 i 104 o 1,50 m na wschód oraz drzwi pomieszczenia 104 o 0,75 m na wschód.

exercise.compare.step3.source: Review the added 6 ft south glazing on A101 and A201, then check the revised issue fields and notes.
exercise.compare.step3.target: Sprawdź nowe okno południowe szerokości 1,50 m na A101 i A201, a następnie zmienione dane wydania i uwagi.

exercise.compare.scope.source: Room 103 changes from 576 to 720 sq ft; room 104 changes from 576 to 432 sq ft. The gross footprint stays 5,760 sq ft. These are authored changes, not a promised detection count.
exercise.compare.scope.target: Pomieszczenie 103 zmienia powierzchnię z 36,00 na 45,00 m²; pomieszczenie 104 z 36,00 na 27,00 m². Obrys pozostaje równy 360,00 m². Są to celowo wprowadzone zmiany, nie gwarantowana liczba wykrytych różnic.

exercise.review.title.source: Review the Willow Creek coordination sheets
exercise.review.title.target: Sprawdź koordynację branżową Domu Sąsiedzkiego Lipowy

exercise.review.step1.source: Open X101 and inspect the three numbered coordination issues and their existing sticky notes.
exercise.review.step1.target: Otwórz X101 i sprawdź trzy ponumerowane kolizje oraz przypisane do nich istniejące notatki PDF.

exercise.review.step2.source: Use X102 to match each location to its issue, trade, status, and requested response. Add your own review markup on a copy.
exercise.review.step2.target: Na X102 powiąż każdą lokalizację z uwagą, branżą, statusem i oczekiwaną odpowiedzią. Dodaj własne adnotacje przeglądowe na kopii.

exercise.review.step3.source: Save the copy, reopen it, and inspect the annotations and any exported Markup Table before handing it off.
exercise.review.step3.target: Zapisz kopię, otwórz ją ponownie i przed przekazaniem sprawdź adnotacje oraz ewentualny eksport tabeli adnotacji.

exercise.review.scope.source: The source contains three authored issues and four PDF layers. These are fictional coordination exercises; no engineering or code-compliance conclusion is established.
exercise.review.scope.target: Oryginał zawiera trzy uwagi do ćwiczeń i cztery warstwy PDF. Fikcyjne ćwiczenia koordynacyjne nie stanowią zatwierdzenia technicznego ani potwierdzenia zgodności z przepisami.

exercise.ocr.title.source: Test OCR on the Willow Creek scanned sheets
exercise.ocr.title.target: Wypróbuj OCR na skanach Domu Sąsiedzkiego Lipowy

exercise.ocr.step1.source: Open the scanned set and try searching for WILLOW CREEK. The original two-page PDF contains images without native text.
exercise.ocr.step1.target: Otwórz zestaw skanów i spróbuj wyszukać SALA WIELOFUNKCYJNA. Oryginalny dwustronicowy PDF zawiera obrazy bez warstwy tekstowej.

exercise.ocr.step2.source: Run OCR on a working copy. Search for COMMUNITY ROOM on A101 and SITE PLAN on C101, then inspect the recognized text.
exercise.ocr.step2.target: Wykonaj OCR na kopii roboczej. Wyszukaj SALA WIELOFUNKCYJNA na A101 i PLAN TERENU I SIECI na C101, a następnie sprawdź rozpoznany tekst.

exercise.ocr.step3.source: Save and reopen the result. Repeat the searches and visually check dimensions before measuring the scanned drawing.
exercise.ocr.step3.target: Zapisz wynik i otwórz go ponownie. Powtórz wyszukiwanie i sprawdź wymiary wzrokowo przed pomiarem zeskanowanego rysunku.

exercise.ocr.scope.source: Search targets are printed source text, not a promise of recognition accuracy. OCR does not repair drawing scale or scan distortion.
exercise.ocr.scope.target: Frazy wyszukiwania są wydrukowane na rysunkach; poprawność rozpoznania nie jest gwarantowana. OCR nie naprawia skali rysunku ani zniekształceń skanu.

library.intro.source: Explore the fictional Willow Creek Community Center through coordinated architectural, structural, civil, MEP, and finish drawings. Every PDF contains two bookmarked ARCH D sheets (36 × 24 inches), with drawing numbers, schedules, legends, dimensions, and details.
library.intro.target: Türkiye'deki kurgusal Ihlamur Mahalle Merkezi'ni birbiriyle uyumlu mimari, taşıyıcı sistem, arazi, tesisat ve kaplama çizimleriyle inceleyin. Her PDF; yer imleri, çizim numaraları, listeler, lejantlar, ölçüler ve detaylar içeren iki A1 paftadan oluşur.

library.scope.source: These are original demonstration drawings, not permit documents or verified PolyPDF outputs. The main building plans use 1/4 inch = 1 foot; site and detail scales vary. Calibrate each view before measuring. Use the sheet-specific examples below. The earlier F-101 and E-101 exercises use different drawings and quantities.
library.scope.target: Bu özgün çizimler gösterim amaçlıdır; ruhsat belgesi veya doğrulanmış PolyPDF çıktısı değildir. Ana kat planları 1:50, vaziyet planları 1:200 ölçeğindedir; detayların kendi ölçekleri vardır. Ölçümden önce her görünüşü kalibre edin ve aşağıdaki alıştırmaları izleyin. Önceki ABD örnekleri F-101 ve E-101 farklı çizimler ve miktarlar kullanır.

exercise.compare.title.source: Compare the Willow Creek architectural revisions
exercise.compare.title.target: Ihlamur Mahalle Merkezi'nin mimari revizyonlarını karşılaştırın

exercise.compare.step1.source: Open Revision A and Revision B. Pair A101 with A101 and A201 with A201; keep the full sheet extents aligned.
exercise.compare.step1.target: A ve B revizyonlarını açın. A101'i A101, A201'i A201 ile eşleştirin; A1 paftalarının tam sınırlarını hizalayın.

exercise.compare.step2.source: On A101, review the 6 ft partition shift between rooms 103 and 104 and the 3 ft movement of the room 104 door.
exercise.compare.step2.target: A101'de 103 ve 104 numaralı odalar arasındaki duvarın 1,50 m, 104 kapısının ise 0,75 m doğuya taşınmasını inceleyin.

exercise.compare.step3.source: Review the added 6 ft south glazing on A101 and A201, then check the revised issue fields and notes.
exercise.compare.step3.target: A101 ve A201'de güneye eklenen 1,50 m genişliğindeki pencereyi, ardından değişen yayın bilgilerini ve notları kontrol edin.

exercise.compare.scope.source: Room 103 changes from 576 to 720 sq ft; room 104 changes from 576 to 432 sq ft. The gross footprint stays 5,760 sq ft. These are authored changes, not a promised detection count.
exercise.compare.scope.target: 103 numaralı oda 36,00 m²'den 45,00 m²'ye; 104 numaralı oda 36,00 m²'den 27,00 m²'ye değişir. Taban alanı 360,00 m² kalır. Bunlar önceden çizilmiş değişikliklerdir; algılanacak fark sayısına ilişkin bir garanti değildir.

exercise.review.title.source: Review the Willow Creek coordination sheets
exercise.review.title.target: Ihlamur Mahalle Merkezi'nin koordinasyon paftalarını inceleyin

exercise.review.step1.source: Open X101 and inspect the three numbered coordination issues and their existing sticky notes.
exercise.review.step1.target: X101'i açın; numaralandırılmış üç koordinasyon sorununu ve bunlara ait mevcut PDF notlarını inceleyin.

exercise.review.step2.source: Use X102 to match each location to its issue, trade, status, and requested response. Add your own review markup on a copy.
exercise.review.step2.target: X102'de her konumu sorun, disiplin, durum ve istenen yanıtla eşleştirin. Kopya üzerine kendi inceleme işaretlemelerinizi ekleyin.

exercise.review.step3.source: Save the copy, reopen it, and inspect the annotations and any exported Markup Table before handing it off.
exercise.review.step3.target: Kopyayı kaydedip yeniden açın. Teslimden önce işaretlemeleri ve varsa dışa aktarılan işaretleme tablosunu kontrol edin.

exercise.review.scope.source: The source contains three authored issues and four PDF layers. These are fictional coordination exercises; no engineering or code-compliance conclusion is established.
exercise.review.scope.target: Özgün dosyada üç alıştırma sorunu ve dört PDF katmanı bulunur. Bu kurgusal koordinasyon alıştırmaları mühendislik onayı veya mevzuata uygunluk sonucu oluşturmaz.

exercise.ocr.title.source: Test OCR on the Willow Creek scanned sheets
exercise.ocr.title.target: Ihlamur Mahalle Merkezi'nin taranmış paftalarında OCR'ı deneyin

exercise.ocr.step1.source: Open the scanned set and try searching for WILLOW CREEK. The original two-page PDF contains images without native text.
exercise.ocr.step1.target: Taranmış seti açıp ÇOK AMAÇLI SALON ifadesini aramayı deneyin. Özgün iki sayfalık PDF, metin katmanı olmayan görüntüler içerir.

exercise.ocr.step2.source: Run OCR on a working copy. Search for COMMUNITY ROOM on A101 and SITE PLAN on C101, then inspect the recognized text.
exercise.ocr.step2.target: Çalışma kopyasına OCR uygulayın. A101'de ÇOK AMAÇLI SALON, C101'de VAZİYET VE ALTYAPI PLANI ifadelerini arayın ve tanınan metni kontrol edin.

exercise.ocr.step3.source: Save and reopen the result. Repeat the searches and visually check dimensions before measuring the scanned drawing.
exercise.ocr.step3.target: Sonucu kaydedip yeniden açın. Aramaları tekrarlayın; taranmış çizimi ölçmeden önce ölçüleri görsel olarak kontrol edin.

exercise.ocr.scope.source: Search targets are printed source text, not a promise of recognition accuracy. OCR does not repair drawing scale or scan distortion.
exercise.ocr.scope.target: Aranacak ifadeler özgün çizimlerde basılıdır; tanıma doğruluğu garanti edilmez. OCR, çizim ölçeğini veya tarama bozulmasını düzeltmez.
